title: Practice 1: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom was a prisoner of war for three years.
exercises.why: Numerals are declined in Russian. They have their own pattern of declension. The number «ОДИН» acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case. ОДИН (ОДНА, ОДНО) declines like этот (ЭТА, ЭТО). Adjectives and possessives after numerals agree as a rule in number, gender and case with the noun they modify: *одна ваша новая машина; пять ваших новых машин.* However, there is an exception to this rule: after 2, 3, 4 (also after compounds ending in 2, 3, 4) the adjective or possessive is in the genitive plural, while the noun is in the genitive singular: *два наших самолёта; двадцать четыре новых самолёта. — DLI, Lesson 70.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Numerals are declined in Russian. (DLI, Lesson 70)

exercises.prompt: I owe Tom thirty bucks.

exercises.context: Numerals are declined in Russian. (DLI, Lesson 70)
